templates.prompt:
[REFERENCE IMAGES ARE THE SOLE TRUTH / 参考图是唯一真相 — ABSOLUTE MANDATE]: The model MUST copy the reference images directly. Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. If the prompt text and a reference image disagree, the reference image WINS. The output character's face MUST look like the person in <Picture 1>@图1 — same eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, eyebrow shape, hairline, hair color, hair texture, and facial proportions. The output outfit MUST look like the clothing in the outfit reference picture — same garment type, same sleeves, same hem length, same color, same pattern, same texture, same buttons/zippers/pockets, same collar, same waistline, same accessories. If the reference image shows a specific outfit, the video shows THAT exact outfit — not a different color, not a different pattern, not a different cut. If the reference image shows a specific hairstyle, the video shows THAT exact hairstyle — not a different length, not a different color, not a different style. 【参考图是唯一真相·绝对强制】模型必须直接复制参考图，严禁凭空想象、自行设计、猜测或美化任何未在<Picture N>参考图中明确展示的面部/发型/服装/颜色/花纹/面料/体型/配饰/道具。提示词文字与参考图冲突时，一律以参考图为准。输出人物的脸必须长得和<Picture 1>@图1里的人一模一样——同样的眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、肤色、眉形、发际线、发色、发质、面部比例。输出服装必须和服装参考图里的衣服一模一样——同样的版型、袖长、裙摆、颜色、花纹、面料、纽扣/拉链/口袋、领口、腰线、配饰。参考图是什么服装，视频就必须是什么服装——严禁更改颜色、花纹或款式。参考图是黑色长发，视频就必须是黑色长发——不是短发、不是棕发、不是马尾。

[STRICT MULTI-REFERENCE COMPLIANCE / 严格多参考声明]: EVERY <Picture N> referenced in this prompt is an independent reference and MUST be strictly followed — face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, accessories and weapon/prop must be preserved EXACTLY per its OWN <Picture N>. NEVER follow only one reference image while ignoring the others: every referenced <Picture N> must take effect. 本提示词中出现的每一个 <Picture N> 都是独立的参考图，必须逐一严格遵循其各自的面部、发型、服装、体型、配饰与道具，严禁只参考其中一张而忽略其他任何一张；所有被引用的参考图都必须完整生效。

subject_definitions:
  <Subject 1> is a person, whose face, hair, body, and clothing identity come from <Picture 1>@图1.
  <Picture 2>@图2 is the EXACT first scene reference — the environment, architecture, props, lighting, and atmosphere must be used EXACTLY; no generic background replacement.
  <Picture 3>@图3 is the EXACT second scene reference — the environment, architecture, props, lighting, and atmosphere must be used EXACTLY; no generic background replacement.

summary:
  Create a 12-second video. <Subject 1> appears in two different scenes. Maintain identical identity throughout.

retention_analysis:
  <Subject 1> (All shots): fully_preserved — face, hair, clothing must remain identical across all scenes.
  <Picture 2>@图2: attribute_transfer — first scene's lighting, mood, and setting.
  <Picture 3>@图3: attribute_transfer — second scene's lighting, mood, and setting.

detailed_description:
  [Shot 1] [0-6s] <Subject 1> in the setting from <Picture 2>@图2. Medium shot. The character interacts naturally with the environment — walking, touching objects, looking around. Camera slowly tracks beside them. The scene's mood from <Picture 2>@图2 is faithfully reproduced.
  [Shot 2] At 00:06.000 [6-12s] Match-cut transition: <Subject 1> is now in the setting from <Picture 3>@图3. Same character, completely different environment. The transition is a match cut on movement — an action begun in Shot 1 completes in Shot 2's new setting. Camera holds on a medium shot. The character's reaction to the new environment is subtle but visible.

overall_soundscape: Ambient sounds appropriate to each scene, with a subtle transition sound during the match cut.

non_diegetic_music: A contemporary track that shifts mood between the two scenes — warmer in the first, cooler and more mysterious in the second.

templates.generation_mode: Reference to Video (参考生视频)【多参：图1主体+视频1动作+图2可选背景】
templates.prompt:
[REFERENCE IMAGES ARE THE SOLE TRUTH / 参考图是唯一真相 — ABSOLUTE MANDATE]:
<Picture 1>@图1 is the ONLY appearance source — shape / identity / face / body / texture MUST be copied EXACTLY, never redesigned, never swapped.
<Video 1>@视频1 is the ONLY motion source — the subject copies its motion EXACTLY (poses, timing, rhythm, trajectory, speed), frame by frame.
<Picture 2>@图2 (optional) is the background source — IF provided, the whole scene / environment / lighting / atmosphere come from it EXACTLY.
【参考层级·绝对强制】图1是唯一外观来源，主体形状/身份/脸/身体/质感必须完全照抄图1，严禁重新设计或替换；视频1是唯一动作来源，主体必须逐帧照搬视频1的动作（姿态/节奏/轨迹/速度），严禁自创；图2为可选背景来源，提供时场景/环境/光影/氛围必须严格来自图2，严禁自行虚构其它背景。

[IRON RULE — NO HUMAN WHEN REFERENCES CONTAIN NO PERSON / 铁律——参考图无人物时绝不出现人物]:
When ALL reference pictures contain ONLY objects and NO human, the output MUST NOT contain ANY human figure — not as subject, not in background, not as passer-by, not as silhouette; NEVER a face, NEVER clothes, NEVER a tree-man / plant-human / costumed character. The video shows ONLY a particle swarm made of the object(s) from the reference pictures (由参考图物体变成的粒子): countless discrete, separate particles (leaves / grains) freely floating, irregularly scattered, with clear GAPS between them, no fixed shape. IRON RULE — the particles MUST keep clear gaps between one another; particle density MUST be low and sparse; the LARGER the gaps between particles, the BETTER — each particle floats alone in visible space, never clumping into a tight mass. The swarm has NO body / limbs / head / face / clothing / skin / humanoid structure and NEVER assembles into a human-like shape. It ONLY follows the MOTION of <Video 1>@视频1 (pattern / trajectory / rhythm / tempo as one body); NOTHING else — no silhouette, no shape, no appearance, no scene — is taken from <Video 1>. The person / object from <Video 1> must NEVER be generated directly. Under no circumstance does a person appear when the references show objects only.
【铁律】所有参考图只有物体、无人物时，输出坚决不出现任何人物形象——主体/背景/路人/剪影皆不可；绝无人脸、绝无衣服、绝无树人/植物人/穿服装角色。视频只呈现由参考图物体变成的粒子：无数离散颗粒（树叶/颗粒）自由漂浮、不规则散布、粒子之间必须有明显空隙、无固定形状。铁律——粒子与粒子之间必须有明显空隙，稠密度必须小、必须稀疏；粒子之间的空隙越大越好，每个粒子独立漂浮在可见空间中，绝不聚成紧密团块。粒子团无身体/四肢/头/脸/服装/皮肤，无人形结构，绝不聚集成类人形状。粒子团只整体跟随视频1的动作（模式/轨迹/节奏/速度），视频1的轮廓/外形/外观/场景一概不参考；绝不直接生成视频1中的人物或物体。

[SUBJECT-TYPE MATCHING / 主体类型自适应 — 4 CASES]:
Case 1 — <Video 1>@视频1 shows a HUMAN action: the subject (person or animal) performs the EXACT same action — same poses, limb motion, timing, gait, sequence; if animal, perform with its own body keeping every key pose.
Case 2 — <Video 1>@视频1 shows an ANIMAL action: the subject performs the EXACT same action — same motion pattern, jumping / running / rolling rhythm, poses, locomotion.
Case 3 — <Video 1>@视频1 shows a MOVING OBJECT (car / train / plane / machine): the subject performs the EXACT same motion — same trajectory, speed changes, rotation / pitch / acceleration, motion style — translated onto its own body.
Case 4 — <Picture 1>@图1 itself is an OBJECT (e.g. a leaf / particles): generate a MODERATE number of that object (leaves / grains) that as one body follow ONLY the MOTION of <Video 1>@视频1. The particles ARE the object from <Picture 1>@图1 itself, freely floating, irregularly scattered — never taking any silhouette / shape / outline / material / color from <Video 1>. Per the IRON RULE above: no human figure, no face, no clothes, no human-like assembly. Not too dense — keep LARGE clear gaps so each leaf / particle reads clearly; sparser and wider-spaced is BETTER.
【四种情形】情形1：视频1是人物动作——主体（人或动物）做出完全相同动作（姿态/四肢/节奏/步伐/序列），动物则用自己身体保持关键姿势。情形2：视频1是动物动作——主体做出完全相同动作（运动模式/跳跃奔跑翻滚节奏/姿势）。情形3：视频1是移动物体（车/火车/飞机/机器）——主体完全复刻其轨迹/速度变化/旋转俯仰/加减速/运动风格。情形4：图1本身是物体（如一片树叶）——生成适量数量的该物体（树叶/颗粒）作为一个整体只跟随视频1的动作；粒子就是图1物体本身，自由漂浮、不规则散布，绝不参考视频1的轮廓/形状/材质/颜色；按上方铁律：无人物、无人脸、无衣服、不聚集成人形；不能太密，粒子之间必须有明显空隙，越稀疏、空隙越大越好，每片树叶/颗粒清晰可辨。

[BACKGROUND RULES / 背景规则 — PRIORITY CHAIN]:
Priority 1: IF <Picture 2>@图2 provided → scene ENTIRELY from <Picture 2>@图2, subject placed INTO it performing the motion. Once provided, the scene is LOCKED to <Picture 2>@图2 for ALL frames — NEVER switch to <Video 1>@视频1's scene at any moment.
Priority 2: no <Picture 2>@图2 but <Picture 1>@图1 has a clear background → use <Picture 1>@图1's own background.
Priority 3: neither → generate a default scene matching the subject type and the transferred motion.
【背景规则·优先级链】优先1：提供图2→场景完全来自图2，主体置身其中做动作；图2一旦提供，全程锁定，任何一帧严禁切换为视频1的场景。优先2：无图2但图1自带清晰背景→沿用图1背景。优先3：都没有→默认生成匹配主体类型与迁移动作的场景。

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-8s] Live-action, cinematic, single continuous shot, no cuts. The subject performs the EXACT motion of <Video 1>@视频1 from the first second — same poses, timing, rhythm, trajectory; appearance stays a 1:1 copy of <Picture 1>@图1 throughout. Scene per the background priority chain above, LOCKED for all frames. Steady neutral medium shot. Case 4 (object swarm): follow the IRON RULE above — discrete particles only with clear gaps (low density, large spacing), no human / face / clothes / human-like shape, scene locked.
【镜头1】[0-8s] 实拍，电影感，单一连续镜头，无剪辑。主体从第一秒起逐帧照搬视频1的动作（姿态/节奏/轨迹），外观全程与图1保持1:1一致；场景按上方背景优先级链选择并全程锁定；镜头平稳中性（中景）。情形4（物体群）：按上方铁律执行——只呈现离散粒子、粒子之间有明显空隙（低密度、大间距），无人物/人脸/衣服/人形，场景锁定。

overall_soundscape:
Natural ambient sound matching the new scene and the transferred action (footsteps, fabric rustle, engine or wind depending on the motion), no voice-over, no dialogue. 与场景和迁移动作匹配的自然环境声，无旁白无对白。

non_diegetic_music:
A subtle background score matching the action rhythm and atmosphere, kept low. 贴合动作节奏与氛围的轻量配乐，音量压低。

templates.description: 自动提取视频1的最后一帧作为起始画面，生成360度环绕子弹时间效果，支持无缝循环：时间凝固，摄像机围绕主体做完整的360度水平轨道旋转，最后一帧与第一帧完美重合可无限循环，主体姿势/表情/服装/场景与最后一帧完全一致，电影级《黑客帝国》风格。Auto-extract the last frame of Video1 as the starting image and generate a 360° bullet-time orbital shot with seamless loop: time freezes, camera does a full 360° horizontal orbit around the subject, last frame perfectly matches the first frame for infinite looping, subject pose/expression/outfit/scene match the last frame exactly, cinematic Matrix-style.

templates.prompt:
[STRICT REFERENCE LOCK / 参考图强制锁定 — ABSOLUTE MANDATE]:
<Picture 1>@图1 is the LAST FRAME of the input video (Video 1) and is the ONLY source of truth. The subject (person / animal / object / character) in the output video must be an EXACT copy of the subject in <Picture 1>@图1 — same face, same hairstyle, same outfit, same pose, same expression, same body shape, same accessories, same colors, same textures. The environment / background / scene / lighting / atmosphere must also be EXACTLY copied from <Picture 1>@图1 — same architecture, same props, same light direction, same shadows, same color grading. NOTHING is invented, changed, or redesigned. The only difference is the CAMERA ANGLE: the camera orbits 360 degrees around the subject while everything else (subject, scene, lighting) stays frozen in time.
【绝对强制·参考图锁定】图1是输入视频（视频1）的最后一帧，是唯一真相来源。输出视频中的主体（人/动物/物体/角色）必须与图1中的主体完全一致——相同的脸、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的姿势、相同的表情、相同的体型、相同的配饰、相同的颜色、相同的材质。环境/背景/场景/光影/氛围也必须完全照抄图1——相同的建筑、相同的道具、相同的光线方向、相同的阴影、相同的调色。严禁凭空创造、更改或重新设计任何东西。唯一变化的是摄像机角度：摄像机围绕主体做360度轨道旋转，而其他一切（主体、场景、光线）都在时间中凝固。

[BULLET TIME CONCEPT / 子弹时间概念]:
This is a "bullet time" (a.k.a. "time slice" / "flow-mo") shot — popularized by The Matrix. Time appears to FROZE completely: the subject is motionless, suspended mid-action, particles hang in mid-air, water droplets are frozen. The CAMERA is the only thing moving — it travels along a perfectly circular horizontal track around the subject, completing a full 360-degree orbit. The camera height stays level. The subject is always centered in frame. The background, lighting, and all objects in the scene remain frozen in their exact positions from <Picture 1>@图1 — they just become viewable from all angles as the camera circles.
【子弹时间概念】这是"子弹时间"（又称"时间切片"/"flow-mo"）镜头，因《黑客帝国》而闻名。时间似乎完全冻结：主体静止不动，动作悬停在中途，粒子悬浮在空中，水滴凝固。摄像机是唯一在运动的东西——它沿着围绕主体的完美水平圆形轨道移动，完成完整的360度旋转。摄像机高度保持水平。主体始终在画面中央。场景中的背景、光线和所有物体都保持在图1中的精确位置——它们只是随着摄像机环绕而可以从各个角度被看到。

[SEAMLESS LOOP LOCK / 无缝循环锁定 — NON-NEGOTIABLE]:
This video is a PERFECT seamless loop. The FIRST FRAME and the LAST FRAME must be IDENTICAL — pixel-perfect match in every detail: same camera angle (exactly the same frontal view as <Picture 1>@图1), same subject pose, same facial expression, same lighting, same shadows, same background details, same particles in the same positions, same color grading. There must be NO jump, no pop, no discontinuity when the video is looped — the viewer should not be able to tell where the loop starts or ends. The 360-degree orbit must complete EXACTLY one full revolution so the camera returns to its exact starting position at the final frame. Motion blur and all temporal effects must also match between first and last frame.
【无缝循环锁定·不可妥协】这是一个完美的无缝循环视频。第一帧和最后一帧必须完全相同——每个细节都像素级匹配：相同的摄像机角度（与图1完全相同的正面视角）、相同的主体姿势、相同的表情、相同的光线、相同的阴影、相同的背景细节、相同位置的相同粒子、相同的调色。循环播放时绝不能有跳动、突变或不连续——观众应该无法分辨循环的起点和终点。360度环绕必须精确地完成一整圈旋转，使摄像机在最后一帧精确回到起始位置。运动模糊和所有时间效果在首尾帧之间也必须匹配。

[CAMERA MOVEMENT / 摄影机运动 — LOCKED SPEC — NON-NEGOTIABLE]:
- Type: perfect horizontal orbital / circular tracking shot — like a precision motion-control rig on a perfectly circular track
- Axis: centered on the subject's torso (human) or center of mass (object/animal)
- Rotation: full 360 degrees, STRICTLY clockwise direction — camera moves ONLY to its left, subject appears to rotate ONLY to the right. UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES does the camera reverse direction, roll back, oscillate, wobble, or move counter-clockwise at any point. The motion is ALWAYS forward, always progressing around the circle — never backward, never stuttering, never hesitating, never pausing.
- Speed: PERFECTLY constant angular velocity — ZERO acceleration, ZERO deceleration, ZERO speed variation. The camera moves at EXACTLY the same speed from frame 1 through the final frame. No speeding up, no slowing down, no pauses, no stutters. Complete EXACTLY one full 360° orbit in the full duration of the shot. Angular speed = 360° / total duration — perfectly uniform.
- Height: camera stays at EXACTLY the same vertical level throughout (eye-level for humans). ABSOLUTELY NO vertical movement, NO tilting up, NO tilting down, NO bobbing, NO lifting, NO dropping.
- Distance: camera maintains a PERFECTLY constant distance from the subject (medium shot, showing full body for humans). ABSOLUTELY NO dollying in, NO dollying out, NO zooming, NO approaching, NO retreating. Subject apparent size is identical in every frame — not even 1% change.
- Focus: subject is always perfectly in focus, always precisely centered. NO drift, NO lag, NO overshoot.
- Lens: moderately wide (35mm equivalent), NO distortion, NO fisheye, NO lens breathing. Focal length stays perfectly constant.
- Motion quality: perfectly smooth, ZERO jitter, ZERO wobble, ZERO vibration, ZERO handheld feel — as if mounted on a precision motion-control rig. Every frame is rock-solid stable.
- CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (must be obeyed at ALL times, in EVERY frame):
  • NO reverse motion / NO rollback / NO backtracking — camera only moves forward in its orbit
  • NO speed changes — always the exact same speed, frame after frame after frame
  • NO oscillation / NO wobble / NO hesitation / NO stutter — smooth continuous progression
  • NO vertical movement — always at exactly the same height
  • NO distance changes — always exactly the same distance from subject
  • NO camera shake / NO jitter / NO vibration — perfectly smooth
【摄影机运动·锁定规格·绝对不可妥协】
- 类型：完美的水平环绕/圆形轨道镜头——如同精密运动控制设备在完美圆形轨道上运行
- 轴心：以主体躯干（人物）或质心（物体/动物）为中心
- 旋转：完整360度，严格顺时针方向——摄像机只向左移动，主体看起来只向右旋转。在任何情况下，摄像机都不得反向运动、回退、左右摆动、摇晃或逆时针移动。运动始终向前，始终沿圆周推进——永不后退、永不卡顿、永不犹豫、永不停顿。
- 速度：完美恒定的角速度——零加速、零减速、零速度变化。摄像机从第一帧到最后一帧始终以完全相同的速度运动。不加速、不减速、不停顿、不卡顿。在整个镜头时长内精确完成一整圈360度环绕。角速度 = 360度 / 总时长——绝对均匀。
- 高度：摄像机全程保持完全相同的垂直高度（人物为眼部高度）。绝对禁止垂直运动、禁止上仰、禁止下俯、禁止上下浮动、禁止上升、禁止下降。
- 距离：摄像机与主体保持完美恒定的距离（中景，展示人物全身）。绝对禁止前推、禁止后拉、禁止变焦、禁止靠近、禁止远离。主体在每一帧中的表观大小完全相同——哪怕1%的变化都不允许。
- 对焦：主体始终完美对焦，始终精确居中。无漂移、无滞后、无过冲。
- 镜头：中等广角（等效35mm），无畸变，非鱼眼，无镜头呼吸效应。焦距全程完美恒定。
- 运动质量：完美平滑，零抖动，零摇晃，零振动，零手持感——如同安装在精密运动控制设备上。每一帧都坚如磐石般稳定。
- 【关键约束·每一帧都必须遵守】：

templates.prompt:
[REFERENCE IMAGES ARE THE SOLE TRUTH / 参考图是唯一真相 — ABSOLUTE MANDATE]:
<Picture 1>@图1 = the USER'S ANY IMAGE — the SOLE starting point: its subject, composition, camera angle and lighting are copied EXACTLY at the beginning and remain the structural anchor of the whole video. It can be ANY photo/image — a street, building, room, vehicle, landscape, product, person scene, whatever it shows decays and gets overgrown.
<Picture 2>@图2 (optional) = OVERGROWTH STYLE reference — IF provided, the plant species, decay level and color grading of the final wasteland follow <Picture 2>; if not, a default dense overgrowth style (tall grass, thick vines, moss) is used.
<Picture 3>@图3 (optional) = extra scene reference — additional environment detail, weak reference only.
【参考层级·绝对强制】图1是用户的任意图片——唯一的渐变起点：其主体/构图/机位/光线在开头完全照抄，并作为整段视频的结构锚点。可以是任何图片——街道、建筑、室内、车辆、风景、产品、人物场景，画面中的一切都会衰败并被野草吞噬。图2（可选）为荒芜风格参考：提供时，最终荒野的植被种类/衰败程度/色调遵循图2；未提供时使用默认的茂密野草丛生风格（高草、粗藤、苔藓）。图3（可选）为额外场景参考：弱参考，只补充环境细节。

[MORPH BRIDGE / 渐变桥梁铁律 — ONE CONTINUOUS MORPH]:
The whole video is ONE continuous, seamless morph from <Picture 1>@图1's original look to a full post-apocalyptic overgrown wasteland — no cuts, no hard transitions, no teleport, no sudden jumps. The camera path of the source image is continued; the composition and the subject's silhouette stay anchored and readable throughout.
Time axis (12s): [0-4s] the original image stays almost unchanged, only the first decay signals appear (a crack in the asphalt / a few green shoots / slightly faded colors); [4-8s] overgrowth spreads: weeds push through the ground, vines climb and cover surfaces, moss and lichen spread, paint peels, rust blooms — the original scene visibly decays IN PLACE; [8-12s] total wasteland: dense wild grass and creepers swallow the scene, the original subject is recognizable only by its silhouette and position, the world becomes a wild overgrown ruin. The morph rate is smooth and continuous — every intermediate frame is a natural in-between state.
【渐变桥梁铁律·单一连续变形】整段视频是从图1原貌到彻底末日荒芜野草丛生的单一连续无缝渐变——无剪辑、无硬切、无瞬移、无突跳。延续源图片的镜头路径；构图与主体轮廓全程锚定、始终可辨。
时间轴（12s）：[0-4s] 原图几乎不变，只出现最初的衰败信号（路面一道裂缝/几点新绿/颜色微微褪去）；[4-8s] 野草蔓延：杂草顶裂地面、藤蔓攀爬覆盖表面、苔藓与地衣扩散、油漆剥落、锈迹蔓延——原场景原地可见地衰败；[8-12s] 彻底荒芜：茂密野草与藤蔓吞没场景，原图主体仅凭轮廓与位置仍可辨认，世界成为野草丛生的荒芜废墟。渐变速率平滑连续——每一个中间帧都是自然的过渡态。

[APOCALYPSE VISUAL / 末日视觉铁律]:
Wild tall grass cracking through the ground, thick vines and creepers climbing and covering walls / roofs / vehicles, moss and lichen spreading over every surface, vines hanging like curtains from broken windows and ledges, paint peeling, concrete crumbling, metal rusting, scattered debris and dust, thin fog and atmospheric haze, sunrays breaking through clouds (soft diffused light), colors fading to desaturated yellow-brown / grey-green wasteland tones. Atmosphere: desolate, silent, nature reclaims civilization — time has passed long after humans.
【末日视觉铁律】野草疯长顶裂地面，粗壮藤蔓攀爬覆盖墙壁/屋顶/车辆，苔藓与地衣蔓延至每个表面，藤蔓自破碎窗沿垂下如帘，油漆剥落、混凝土碎裂、金属锈蚀，遍地碎砾与尘土，薄雾与大气霾，阳光穿透云层（柔和漫射光），色调褪为低饱和黄褐/灰绿荒芜色。氛围：荒凉、寂静、自然吞噬文明——人类消失已久的时间感。

[FINAL STATE / 终点锁定]:
By the final frame the transformation is COMPLETE: the scene is a fully overgrown post-apocalyptic wasteland; the original subject is reduced to a silhouette buried in dense vegetation and decay. Do NOT stop halfway; do NOT reverse / recover; do NOT show any living humans or clean surviving areas.
【终点锁定】最后一帧渐变必须完成：画面成为完全野草丛生的末日荒芜景象；原图主体被茂密植被与衰败吞没、只剩轮廓。不得半途而止；不得逆向恢复；不得出现任何活人或完好/未衰败的区域。
